scope: Selected evidence units, not a census or count of unique publications.
cutoff: Literature through 12 November 2026. The frozen analytic cohort dates from 3 October 2026; two pre-cutoff works were recovered on 9 October; later units were coded from primary sources added on 19 October and 7–12 November and re-read on 14 November 2026 (UTC).

coding_notes.NR: Not reported in extracted evidence; not necessarily absent from primary source.
coding_notes.organization: Designed, learned, and emergent may coexist.
coding_notes.scale: Concurrent, cumulative, capacity kept separate; protocol roles need not imply simultaneous calls.
coding_notes.quantitative_synthesis: No outcomes pooled; no experiments rerun.
coding_notes.provenance: Per-record chapter/card locators trace inherited evidence; no independent dual coding.
coding_notes.targeted_recovery: coherence-driven-contagion (October 2) and rheon-consensus (September 30, already scouted) were qualified from parent-read primary sections on October 9; neither is a post-cutoff publication.
coding_notes.evaluation_extent: Configurations, tasks, datasets, trials, seeds, replications, samples, steps, model calls, and edits are recorded separately from cumulative agent identities or sessions. Account/name/registration totals are explicitly marked identity proxies.
coding_notes.november_2026_edition: Units with provenance.archive equal to "primary source read for the November 2026 edition" were coded directly from the cited primary source; their sha256 records the retrieved file. The orgs field gives title-page affiliations; NR means none recorded here.
